_comment: Authored one-line descriptions for the 77 Banking77 intents, in exact label-index order (keys map index -> name; see the pinned dataset card at training/data/jev_sources.lock.json). Used as `choice` criteria descriptions in training/build_jev_sources.py; committed content, not fetched data.

intents.activate_my_card: Wants to activate a newly issued card.
intents.age_limit: Asks about the minimum or maximum age to use the service.
intents.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Asks whether Apple Pay or Google Pay is supported.
intents.atm_support: Asks where or whether ATMs can be used.
intents.automatic_top_up: Wants to set up automatic top-ups of the balance.
intents.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: Reports that the balance did not update after a bank transfer.
intents.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: Reports that the balance did not update after a cheque or cash deposit.
intents.beneficiary_not_allowed: Reports that a chosen beneficiary is not allowed for transfers.
intents.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel a transfer that has been made.
intents.card_about_to_expire: Reports or asks about a card that is about to expire.
intents.card_acceptance: Asks where the card is accepted, in stores, online or abroad.
intents.card_arrival: Asks when a new card will arrive.
intents.card_delivery_estimate: Asks for the estimated delivery time of a card.
intents.card_linking: Wants to link the card to an account or an app.
intents.card_not_working: Reports that the card does not work.
intents.card_payment_fee_charged: Asks why a fee was charged for a card payment.
intents.card_payment_not_recognised: Reports a card payment on the statement that is not recognised.
intents.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Reports a wrong exchange rate on a card payment.
intents.card_swallowed: Reports that an ATM kept the card.
intents.cash_withdrawal_charge: Asks why a fee was charged for a cash withdrawal.
intents.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: Reports a cash withdrawal that is not recognised.
intents.change_pin: Wants to change the card PIN.
intents.compromised_card: Reports a compromised or unsafe card.
intents.contactless_not_working: Reports that contactless payment does not work.
intents.country_support: Asks whether the service is supported in a given country.
intents.declined_card_payment: Reports a card payment that was declined.
intents.declined_cash_withdrawal: Reports a cash withdrawal that was declined.
intents.declined_transfer: Reports a transfer that was declined.
intents.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Reports a direct debit payment that is not recognised.
intents.disposable_card_limits: Asks about the limits of disposable virtual cards.
intents.edit_personal_details: Wants to edit personal details in the account.
intents.exchange_charge: Asks about a fee charged for an exchange of currency.
intents.exchange_rate: Asks about the current or applied exchange rate.
intents.exchange_via_app: Wants to exchange currency through the app.
intents.extra_charge_on_statement: Reports an extra or unexpected charge on the statement.
intents.fiat_currency_support: Asks which fiat currencies are supported.
intents.get_disposable_virtual_card: Wants to get a disposable virtual card.
intents.get_physical_card: Wants to order a physical card.
intents.getting_spare_card: Asks about getting a spare or second card.
intents.getting_virtual_card: Asks about getting a virtual card.
intents.lost_or_stolen_card: Reports a lost or stolen card.
intents.lost_or_stolen_phone: Reports a lost or stolen phone that gives access to the account.
intents.order_physical_card: Wants a physical card to be ordered and mailed.
intents.passcode_forgotten: Has forgotten the passcode or login credentials.
intents.pending_card_payment: Asks about a card payment that is still pending.
intents.pending_cash_withdrawal: Asks about a cash withdrawal that is still pending.
intents.pending_top_up: Asks about a top-up that is still pending.
intents.pending_transfer: Asks about a transfer that is still pending.
intents.pin_blocked: Reports a blocked PIN or asks how to unblock it.
intents.receiving_money: Asks how money can be received into the account.
intents.Refund_not_showing_up: Reports that a refund has not shown up yet.
intents.request_refund: Wants a refund for a payment.
intents.reverted_card_payment?: Reports a card payment that was reverted or reversed.
intents.supported_cards_and_currencies: Asks which cards and currencies are supported.
intents.terminate_account: Wants to close or terminate the account.
intents.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Asks about the charge for topping up by bank transfer.
intents.top_up_by_card_charge: Asks about the charge for topping up by card.
intents.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Wants to top up the balance with cash or a cheque.
intents.top_up_limits: Asks about the limits on top-ups.
intents.top_up_reverted: Reports a top-up that was reverted.
intents.topping_up_by_card: Wants to top up the balance using a card.
intents.transaction_charged_twice: Reports a transaction that was charged twice.
intents.transfer_fee_charged: Asks why a fee was charged for a transfer.
intents.transfer_into_account: Wants to transfer money into the account.
intents.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: Reports that the recipient has not received a transfer.
intents.transfer_timing: Asks how long a transfer takes.
intents.unable_to_verify_identity: Reports being unable to complete identity verification.
intents.verify_my_identity: Wants to verify identity in the app.
intents.verify_source_of_funds: Is asked to verify the source of their funds.
intents.virtual_card_not_working: Reports that a virtual card does not work.
intents.visa_or_mastercard: Asks whether Visa or Mastercard is accepted.
intents.why_verify_identity: Asks why identity verification is required.
intents.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: Reports the wrong amount of cash received.
intents.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: Reports a wrong exchange rate on a cash withdrawal.
